Ingredients

1 kg potatoes, peeled and diced

1 cup peas

1 cup finely chopped onions

2 table spoons vegetable oil

1 cup gram flour (chakla)

1 tsp mustard seeds

1 tsp urad-dhal

1 tsp fenugreek (methi) seeds

1 tsp black gram (split kidney beans)

1 tsp tomato paste

Salt to taste

1/2 cup fried onions

1/2 cup fried gram flour (chakla)

Coriander powder

1 tsp garam masala

1/2 tsp cumin powder

Ghee

Method

Wash and cut the potatoes in small cubes, then boiled them in salted water till soft. Drain, mash and set aside. Add peas, onions and cook until onion turns transparent.

Add gram flour, mustard seeds, urad-dhal, methi seeds, black gram, tomato paste, salt, garam masala, cumin powder and fry well. Add water, cover and cook till the potatoes turn pink.

Turn off the flame and keep aside for five minutes.

Take 1/2 cup fried onions and 1/2 cup fried gram flour. Mix well and keep aside.

Now for the actual ki tikki, take 3 inch deep frying pan and pour 1/2 cup ghee, so that it coats the pan. Add mustard seeds and sprinkle half of the  urad-dhal and add fried onions. Fry until golden.

Add the curry and fry for a minute.

Add the mashed potatoes and fry for a minute. Then add the chick-peas and fry till crisp. Put fried onions and gram flour and fry for a minute.

Add 2-3 tbsp water and season with salt and mix well.

Divide the ki tikki into 8 equal parts. Then roll it. Dip it in the fried gram flour and fry on both sides in ghee till brown.

Ingredients for Chimol:

4 pounds of pork shoulder

3 cups of chopped red onion

2 cups of chopped green pepper

1 cup of chopped zucchini

1 cup of chopped potatoes

2 cups of chopped carrots

2 cups of chopped yams

2 cloves of garlic

1 teaspoon of dried oregano

1 teaspoon of dried thyme

1 teaspoon of ground cumin

1 teaspoon of salt

4. After the vegetables have cooked, put the pork back into the pot and add the red wine and vegetable broth.

5. Simmer on low for an additional 4 hours.

6. After it has been simmering for 4 hours, put the pork back into the pot, stir the mixture and cook it down for about 30 minutes.

7. When the pork is ready, peel it and cut it into bite-sized pieces.

8. Serve chimol hot.
